text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Snack time, snack time♪
Hey, Dia-chan, what should we try next?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I've already tried the 'Inferno Hot! Habanero Carrot Gummies' and the 'Super Giant ☆ 50cm Horseshoe Lollipop'...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aha, the school store here is so weird, right?!
It's full of stuff you'd never see anywhere else...
Where do they even get it from...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, look, Dia-chan!
They have 'Umamusume Biscuits'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "If I remember right, it's the biscuits with alphabet letters printed on them, right!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're right... Hehe, brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When I first started hanging out with Kita-chan,
this was the first thing we ate together in the park.

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
"One of our customers gave this to me!
Dia-chan, let's eat it together!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"At home, snacks were always served
on a plate, so..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eating snacks straight out of the bag was a first for me, so it made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, did that really happen?
You've got such a great memory, Dia-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but there's something I remember too!
Dia-chan, you used biscuits to teach me,
"This is how you write KITA!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, this is today's snack, decided!
Hey, the weather's nice, so let's eat outside!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I agree!
Just like that park back in the day...
